context: A uni intern interviews a manager about logistics processes
purpose: Teach: 利子/就労/運輸/納め/間隔/有益/問合せ/外観

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はお時間をいただき、ありがとうございます。御社の運輸業務について、いくつかお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. May I ask a few questions about your transportation operations?
lines.style: Polite, formal interview opener with humble student tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。学生さんの研究に少しでも有益な話ができればうれしいですよ。
lines.en: Of course. I'd be glad if I can share something useful for your research.
lines.style: Warm, welcoming office worker, encouraging and friendly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まず、配送の間隔はどのように決めていらっしゃるんですか。
lines.en: First, how do you decide the intervals between deliveries?
lines.style: Curious, businesslike question with measured politeness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 需要に応じて柔軟に変えています。繁忙期は短く、閑散期は長めにとる感じですね。
lines.en: We adjust flexibly based on demand—shorter during busy seasons, longer during quiet ones.
lines.style: Clear, professional explanation in calm office register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。倉庫の外観を拝見しましたが、かなり大きな施設ですね。働いていらっしゃる方は何人ほどですか。
lines.en: I see. I saw the warehouse exterior—it's quite a large facility. How many people work there?
lines.style: Observational follow-up showing the intern took notes politely.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 現在は約二百名です。就労形態はさまざまで、正社員のほかにパートやアルバイトの方もいらっしゃいますよ。
lines.en: Currently about two hundred. Employment types vary—we have full-timers as well as part-time and casual staff.
lines.style: Natural HR-focused answer staying on the staffing topic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勉強になります。差し支えなければ、設備投資の資金繰りについても少しお伺いしたいのですが。
lines.en: That's helpful. If you don't mind, I'd also like to ask a bit about how you finance facility investments.
lines.style: Polite topic-shift request, careful student register with hedging.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、大型の倉庫は銀行借入で建てましたので、毎月利子をきちんと納めながら少しずつ返済しています。
lines.en: Sure—we built the large warehouse with a bank loan, so we steadily repay it while paying the interest each month.
lines.style: Candid finance explanation, naturally tying interest payments to the loan.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。もし追加で質問が出てきた場合、お問合せはメールでよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Thank you. If additional questions come up, would email be the right way to reach out?
lines.style: Polite closing inquiry, professional follow-up protocol.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、いつでもどうぞ。今日のインタビュー、頑張ってくださいね。
lines.en: Yes, anytime please. Good luck with the rest of your interview today.
lines.style: Friendly, supportive sign-off from the manager.
